task.goal: Build a polished, responsive planetary photo gallery website using the three provided real NASA raster images and image-sources.json. Use plain HTML/CSS/JS and no dependencies. Create index.html, styles.css and app.js in one useful batch. Use an editorial science-magazine composition, strong typography, careful spacing, real images with descriptive alt text and source credit. Do not invent image URLs or use placeholders. Three columns at desktop; one column at 390px; object-fit cover/contain; no overflow or overlapping images. Implement functional Mars/All filters, persistent Earth favorite using localStorage, and an accessible Earth detail dialog closed by Escape. Acceptance selectors: each of three cards data-testid="card"; filter buttons data-testid="filter-mars" and "filter-all"; Earth favorite data-testid="favorite-earth" with aria-pressed; detail button data-testid="detail-earth"; dialog role="dialog". Selectors are a test contract, not styling instructions. Inspect desktop and mobile and test actual actions. Batch writes; do not repeatedly read files already supplied; do not call a model for deterministic verification. Finish only after real browser checks.
